title: USGS Wildland Fire Combined Dataset 2021
description: A combined, de-duplicated national database of wildland fire perimeters for the United States, compiled by the USGS from dozens of federal, state, and local data sources. The combined dataset merges overlapping records by assigning a canonical polygon from the highest-quality available source, while recording all original source attributes. Covers fire events from 1878 through 2021 across the continental US, Alaska, Hawaii, and US territories.
